adequacy_assessment.readme_purpose: unified N/K/F axes, shared counter/timer catalogs, per-spike baselines, comparator normalization, metric sources

coverage.unified_nkf_axes: comprehensive - Section 'Unified axes' defines N (total scope), K (change size), F (derived fan-out) with spike-specific interpretations and scaling implications
coverage.shared_counter_catalog: partial - Section lists union of counters but lacks per-spike collection guidance; references R12/R17/R4 but doesn't explain mapping
coverage.per_spike_baselines: comprehensive - 'Baselines' table maps each spike to comparison baseline and hold-equal conditions
coverage.comparator_normalization: comprehensive - Detailed rules for versioning, sorting, join semantics, stale/current gating, disjoint set assertions
coverage.metric_sources: comprehensive - Five code locations identified with line ranges for TxMetricsJson, log_index_range, TS_* counters, Transition timestamps, maxObservedTimestamp

adequacy_assessment.missing_elements: 1) No citation by any of four spike plans despite being designed to unify them; 2) Counter/timer catalogs lack concrete per-spike collection patterns (which counters apply to 1a vs 1b vs 1c vs Dir 2); 3) No guidance on 'received page results', 'live/changed pages', 'current publications' metrics explicitly mentioned in 1b-R12; 4) Lacks explanation of how test-only TS_* coverage counters translate to production instrumentation; 5) No frontmatter for document metadata

citation_audit.citation_risk: high - document was designed to unify spike measurement but is not referenced by any spike plan; spikes define their own metric requirements (R12/R14/R17/R18) instead of citing this framework, risking inconsistent measurement and duplication

notes: All verified code references are accurate and current. Document provides the conceptual framework for cross-spike measurement but lacks concrete implementation guidance. Spike plans independently define metrics (1b-R12, 1c-R17/R18, Dir 2-R12/R15) rather than adopting this doc's shared catalog, suggesting either poor discoverability or insufficient specificity. Document lacks YAML frontmatter (should include: title, type: research-note, status: active, direction: shared, date: 2026-09-11). Recommendation: Add frontmatter, enhance counter/timer sections with explicit per-spike mappings, and add explicit citations in spike plans to establish this as authoritative measurement framework.
